title: Ligerium
description: Lightweight pack with top optimization mods for smoother and faster Minecraft. Boost FPS and reduce lag with a clean, performance-focused mod selection. Pure performance mods to enhance Minecraft without changing vanilla gameplay.
body:
⚡ This Mod Pack includes only the best optimization mods for Minecraft, carefully curated to deliver maximum performance without altering the vanilla gameplay.
❌ No shaders, ❌ no controller mods, ❌ no cosmetic additions.
Just pure performance.

Perfect for players who want:

- 🚀 Higher FPS
- 🧊 Less lag and faster loading times
- 🛡️ Improved stability
- 🎮 A fully vanilla experience — just optimized

✨ Simple, lightweight, and 100% performance-focused.
